title: StandardValueSetTranslation - Metadata API
description: Contains details for a standard picklist translation. It returns a translated standard value set.This type extends the Metadata metadata type and inherits its fullName field.

valueTranslation.description: A list of values from global value sets to be translated.

declarative_metadata_sample_definition.description: The following is an example of a StandardValueSetTranslation component. When a value isn’t translated, its translation becomes a comment that’s paired with its label.
